🎥🎬: This Is Us (2016–2022)

This Is Us follows the Pearson family across several generations, moving between the past, present, and future to show how the choices of parents shape the lives of their children. Jack and Rebecca Pearson raise their three children—Kevin, Kate, and Randall—while dealing with love, loss, addiction, family struggles, and the challenges of parenthood.

As the children grow older, their own relationships, careers, marriages, and personal struggles unfold. Randall searches for answers about his biological father, Kevin struggles with fame and finding purpose, and Kate works through her relationship with food, self-worth, and family.

Through different timelines, the family experiences births, deaths, marriages, reunions, and painful setbacks. At its heart, the series is about how family remains connected through generations, even after loss and despite the complicated paths each person takes.
